Noah: Hey team — PR up for a shard-key rollout on events + resumable backfill. Can someone take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5421. Adds `organization_id` as the partition/shard key and a backfill job. Running on staging now. CC @Maria @Cheng :eyes:
Maria: On it, will skim now. Any expected downtime?
Noah: No write downtime. Readers might see slightly higher latency while backfill sweeps. Backfill is throttled to ~50 qps and is resumable. Also added a NOTIFY for consumers.
Cheng: Skimming. If backfill exceeds the maintenance window how do we handle pause/resume?
Noah: It's resumable via a cursor stored in `backfills.job_state`. We can cancel and resume from last cursor. Plan: run during low-traffic window, but prepared to abort and resume.
Noah: Migration snippet for quick review:
```sql
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN organization_id uuid DEFAULT NULL;
-- populate in batches to avoid locks
UPDATE events SET organization_id = org_id WHERE organization_id IS NULL LIMIT 10000;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON events (organization_id, created_at DESC);
```
CI-bot: CI checks passed ✅ (migrations, unit tests, integration-tests).
Maria: LGTM on the SQL and tests. One small nit: add a code comment explaining why `created_at DESC` is used in the index. Otherwise approve.
Cheng: Left a tiny comment on the PR about setting `lock_timeout` before the ALTER to avoid long DDL waits. If we set `lock_timeout = '5s'` in the migration wrapper, I'm good to approve.
Noah: Thanks — I'll add the comment and the lock_timeout change. Planning to merge during the 02:00 PST window tomorrow and notify ops.
Ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — merge window 02:00 PST tomorrow. #eng-infra will be paged if the backfill job exceeds expected runtime.
Maria: :thumbsup:
